powers: For your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +2.
When you defeat a monster on your turn, you may shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck. (☐ If it is a weapon, you may put it on top of your deck instead.)
☐ Add 1d4 (☐ 1d8) to your non-combat check against a bane.

roles.name: Death's Heretic
powers: For your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +2 (☐ +4).
When you defeat a monster on your turn, you may shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck. (☐ If it is a weapon, you may put it on top of your deck instead.)
☐ Add 1d4 (☐ 1d8) to your non-combat check against a bane.
☐ When you would discard a weapon for its power, you may recharge it instead (☐ If the weapon is The Melted Blade, you may reveal it instead.)
☐ At the start of your turn, if you do not have a weapon in your hand, you may draw a card. (☐ If the weapon The Melted Blade is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck first.)
☐ Add 1d4 (☐ +1) to a combat check by another character at your location.
☐ If the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Basic or Pharasma trait, add 1 die to your check to defeat.

roles.name: Reluctant Priest
powers: For your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +2.
When you defeat a monster on your turn, you may shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck. (☐ If it is a weapon, you may put it on top of your deck instead.)
☐ Add 1d4 (☐ 1d8) to your non-combat check against a bane (☐ or your combat check against a bane that has the Outsider trait).
☐ On your turn, you may banish a spell to summon and play a spell that has the Divine trait and an adventure deck number no greater than 2 (☐ 4).
☐ At the start of your turn, if you do not have a blessing (☐ and a spell) in your hand, you may draw a card. (☐ You may shuffle your deck first.)
☐ Blessings that have the Pharasma trait played on your checks add d12 instead of the normal die.
